passives.name: Rage Stack XI
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Each turn, increases own ATK by [Buff_V_common_tower_buff_1]. When a bleeding target takes action, restores Max HP [Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_1] and WG [Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_2], and reduces damage taken by [Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_6]. While not enraged, WG damage taken is reduced by [Buff_V_tower_boss_10_1_4].
